signature.name: VTask.ofLine
signature.type: {X : Type u_1} -> [TopologicalSpace X] -> {x y : X} -> {f : ℝ → X} -> (hf : ContinuousOn f unitInterval) -> (h₀ : f 0 = x) -> (h₁ : f 1 = y) -> Path x y

conventions.statement: The path evaluates at t : unitInterval as f applied to the coercion of t to ℝ; no reparametrisation or extension is performed.
conventions.note: The underlying function is the literal restriction of f to unitInterval.

facts.statement: ∀ {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {x y : X} {f : ℝ → X} (hf : ContinuousOn f unitInterval) (h₀ : f 0 = x) (h₁ : f 1 = y) (t : unitInterval), VTask.ofLine hf h₀ h₁ t ∈ f '' unitInterval

facts.statement: ∀ {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {x y : X} {f : ℝ → X} (hf : ContinuousOn f unitInterval) (h₀ : f 0 = x) (h₁ : f 1 = y), Continuous (VTask.ofLine hf h₀ h₁)

facts.statement: ∀ {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {x y : X} {f g : ℝ → X} (hf : ContinuousOn f unitInterval) (hg : ContinuousOn g unitInterval) (h₀ : f 0 = x) (h₁ : f 1 = y) (h₀' : g 0 = x) (h₁' : g 1 = y), (∀ t : unitInterval, f t = g t) → VTask.ofLine hf h₀ h₁ = VTask.ofLine hg h₀' h₁'

facts.statement: ∀ {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {x y : X} (γ : Path x y) (t : unitInterval), VTask.ofLine (γ.continuous_extend.continuousOn) (Path.extend_zero γ) (Path.extend_one γ) t = γ t
